title: Question on the page "Getting started"
body: Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[Getting started](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/getting-started.html)". **I am unable to initialize instant search.js** - Steps I have done so far, add instantsearch.js, instantsearch.min.css, and instantsearch-theme-algolia.css in my index.html file. The Page does not show up when I run the page. My files, showing how I have done it so far. The app.js file

comments.body:
In the beginning of `app.js` you're creating the `const search` two times, which will throw an error because you can't reassign `const` declarations. There's also a stray `2` there. 

This is likely what's going wrong. If you have more issues, please make a [codeSandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js)

@bobylito   @Haroenv I removed the const second time but no luck. Do you have tutorials showing how to set it up? 

Your Sandbox is not working as well.

Sorry for closing, that was an accident. I see the example working perfectly. Which browser & OS are you trying this on? Could you try to give your code on a place where I can try it out as well, either via codeSandbox, or on GitHub? The guide for getting started is [here](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/usage.html)

@Haroenv 
Chrome 68
MacOS HighSierra

I created a sandbox here below https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js 

Test and see which file or item is missing.

That works perfectly for me, also on that version of Chrome. Did you try the standalone view? https://xo94wl403z.codesandbox.io/

Also, what was the result of following the regular getting started guide?

Locally the page is blank but the standalone site is working perfectly. 

Can I send my zipped project so you can review?
sure, you can put it on a GitHub repository, so I can make a change recommendation directly

This is my exact layout on desktop https://github.com/JamesVanWaza/algolia-instantsearch-demo 

Also, please the updated zip file for the instant-search-demo to use the new version of instant search.js.

Hey @JamesVanWaza, I did https://github.com/JamesVanWaza/algolia-instantsearch-demo/pull/1 as a suggestion, but otherwise it works completely for me. You might have a different problem set up on your computer?
@Haroenv it now works, The duplicate was the problem. Thank You so much for the help.
glad we got to the bottom of this, and sorry that it took so long!
@Haroenv did you update the instantjs demo to use version 2.10.1
